mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite sustained GDPC1 growth (t-test p > 0.05), or a downward revision to GDPC1's vintage value invalidates the trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the Federal Funds Rate above 3% signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive over 20d in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS crosses above 3%, or FEDFUNDS remains above 3% for less than 30 days post-crossing.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the Federal Funds Rate and decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signal conflicting monetary policy and weak supply-side demand, amplifying bearish sentiment and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive over 5d in > 70% of triggered instances despite the combined signal, or the FEDFUNDS-INDPRO relationship decays below -0.5 correlation within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the Unemployment Rate above 5% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which depresses equity valuations and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive over 60d in > 50% of triggered instances despite UNRATE crossing above 5%, or the UNRATE trend reverses within 30 days post-crossing.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) reflects a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above previous 3-month average and UNRATE crosses below previous 3-month average
failure_condition: SPX returns negative over 20d in > 60% of triggered instances despite the combined labor market signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS and UNRATE drops below 0.7 within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion' regime, a sustained upward crossing of the Federal Funds Rate above 3% intensifies monetary tightening, amplifying discount rate pressure on equities and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive over 5d in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when FEDFUNDS crosses above 3%, or the FEDFUNDS-SPX correlation drops below -0.3 in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) suggests conflicting demand-side and supply-side pressures, weakening growth prospects and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above previous 3-month average and INDPRO crosses below previous 3-month average
failure_condition: SPX returns positive over 60d in > 50% of triggered instances despite the combined signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 and INDPRO falls below -0.4 within 90 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'post-shock recovery' regime, a sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative over 20d in > 60% of instances during post-shock recovery when FEDFUNDS crosses below 2%, or the FEDFUNDS-SPX correlation drops above 0.2 in such periods.
